# Claude's chess engine vs Stockfish

A chess engine Claude Code (Opus 5.5) wrote from scratch in JavaScript from one prompt, with no chess libraries.
Then it climbed a Stockfish 19 ladder until it lost.

**Play it:** https://denzil10.github.io/claude-chess-engine/

Files: `engine.js` (search and evaluation, runs in Node and the browser), `uci.js` (UCI wrapper), `index.html` (play page; `?pgn=` replays a game), `test/` and `tools/` (the agent's own tests and match runner).

## The ladder
Stockfish 19 with `UCI_LimitStrength` at rising `UCI_Elo`, 1 second per move, 2 games per round (Claude's engine plays White, then Black). One point climbs; less is out. Script: `ladder/ladder.py`. PGNs: `ladder/`.

Claude's own prediction before the ladder: lose around UCI_Elo 2800–2900. Result: cleared 2800 (1½–½), out at 3000 (0–2).
